_note: The supplier side (world/supplier-side.mjs): each supplier's contact person, how they write, and what they will agree to. Read with data/world/<size>/suppliers.json (lead times, terms) and data/organisations.json supplier_constraints (capacity, disruptions). Every number here is an assumption chosen to look like a small UK trade supplier, not measured. Contacts are storybook characters (out of copyright) who are not customers of the shop.

rules._note: reply_after_working_days: a supplier answers on the next working day; slow_reply_after_working_days when the relationship has gone cool. memory_days: how far back a supplier remembers rudeness and late payment. busy_share: an expedite needs the shop's open orders with that supplier to be under this share of a week's capacity. late_payment_grace_days: a bill paid this many days after its terms is not counted as late. Standing starts at 0: each rude email counts rude, each late payment late_payment, each agreed change beyond changes_free in changes_days counts per_extra_change, each polite thank-you counts thanks (at most thanks_cap in all). At or below cool_at the supplier answers more slowly and halves what it offers; at or below no_favours_at it refuses changes altogether.
